releases.name: Ponytail on Stimulants 0.5.1
releases.body:
- Recap outcomes use the turn's answer from before a completion pass rather
  than the pass's verification note, and skip bare label lines such as
  `Completion check:`. OpenCode subagent sessions (with a parent) and
  `pi-subagents` children are not recapped; their parent turn is.
- `scripts/codex-hooks.js install|uninstall` writes the fork's Codex hooks as
  user-level hooks in `$CODEX_HOME/hooks.json` for Codex builds that skip
  plugin-bundled hooks (`plugin_hooks` off, as in Codex 0.162.1). Only fork
  matcher groups are owned; `scripts/uninstall.js` removes them and their state.
- Pi installs document `npm:ponytail-on-stimulants`, which
  `pi update --extensions` keeps current.

releases.name: Ponytail on Stimulants 0.5.0
releases.body:
- Every operational gate (Pi/OMP `agent_end`, Claude/Codex `Stop`, OpenCode V2
  execution-success and V1 idle events) appends one deterministic TSV line per
  settled turn, in every mode, to
  `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/ponytail-on-stimulants/recaps.tsv`:
  time, harness, project, branch, session, turn stats, and `ask → outcome`.
  Turns with a queued completion pass, aborted, interrupted and continuation
  turns are not recapped; each turn is recorded once across hook processes.
- No model call; text is markdown-stripped, secret-redacted and truncated.
  `PONYTAIL_ON_STIMULANTS_RECAP=0` / `"recap": false` disables it and
  `PONYTAIL_ON_STIMULANTS_RECAP_FILE` / `"recapFile"` relocates it.
- Test entry points preload `tests/isolate-recaps.cjs` so the suite never writes
  to a real index. Prompt bodies and completion-pass behavior are unchanged.

releases.name: Ponytail on Stimulants 0.4.3
releases.body: OpenCode 2.0.32 compatibility-validated maintenance release with current Node LTS/npm/uv/Python CI tooling. Dependency-free runtime and prompt bodies unchanged; twelve release-version entries synchronized. 199 root tests, 27 Pi tests, completion and agentic self-tests, npm 11/12 artifact checks and model-free plugin activation passed. The existing trusted-publishing pipeline validates and publishes the exact npm artifact.

releases.name: Ponytail on Stimulants v0.4.2
releases.body:
Fix OMP catalog version drift: both marketplace metadata and plugin entry now match the package and native manifests. The release guard now validates all 12 version fields and tests reject independently stale catalog versions.

Includes the v0.4.x native harness refresh and completion/safety fixes. Published through GitHub trusted publishing with signed npm provenance. 226 root/Pi tests, completion fixtures, offline benchmark instruments and release artifact checks pass.

Install ponytail-on-stimulants@0.4.2; native marketplace metadata now also resolves 0.4.2.

releases.name: Ponytail on Stimulants v0.4.1
releases.body:
## Harness refresh, fork discipline preserved
- Native OpenCode V2 and legacy V1 integrations, with real lifecycle events, commands, skills, compaction and bounded completion prompts.
- Pi/OMP prompt preservation, branch-mode restoration, autocomplete, abort handling and headless safety.
- Codex, Copilot, Qoder and Cursor contract fixes; safer cross-platform hook launchers and state cleanup.
- Conservative uninstall behavior, complete npm discovery metadata, safer review/debt skills, and benchmark integrity fixes.

225 tests, completion fixtures, offline benchmark instruments and release artifact checks pass. Real Pi 1.1.0, OMP 18.10.3 and OpenCode 2.0.29 loaders were exercised without model requests. See docs/harness-compatibility.md for tested/researched boundaries.

Published to npm as ponytail-on-stimulants@0.4.1 using GitHub trusted publishing and signed provenance. This also fixes the initial publishing tarball-path bug; v0.4.0 was tagged but not published. No upstream prompt replacement or new comparative benchmark claim.
